select p.id as playerId, p.member_id as memberId, p.player_no as playerNo, mp.nickname as nickname, p.game_nickname as gameNickname, p.certification_status as certificationStatus from basket_player_profile p left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where p.is_delete = 0 and p.certification_status = 3 and not exists ( select 1 from basket_captain_grant g where g.player_id = p.id and g.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and g.is_delete = 0 and (g.team_id is null or g.active_unique_key is not null) ) order by p.certified_time desc
